name: complete_multistep_booking
description: Complete the three-step booking form. Step 1: choose destination #destination as value tokyo, set #checkin to YYYY-MM-DD, set #nights and #guests as numbers, then click #next1. Step 2: fill representative details; #phone requires digits only with no hyphens, then click #next2. Step 3: click #submit. Finish only after #result shows SUCCESS.
